name: Empyrean Radiant Censor
loreTies: A lower hierarchic enforcer that burns contradiction from trespassers; beautiful, severe, and terrifyingly procedural.
Marks the Deity and supports disciplined ranged fire.
source culture humans later copied as angelic and heavenly lore
shortBackstory: Empyrean Radiant Censor is a lore-faithful Empyrean run-in creature used when missions or events justify faction contact without rewriting the faction or creating playable squads.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Empyrean Radiant Censor belongs to The Radiant Hierarchies and exists to express Empyrean law, pressure, or defense during Gate instability.

chapters.title: Faction Function
chapters.text: Marks the Deity and supports disciplined ranged fire.

chapters.title: Lore Guardrail
chapters.text: Do not use as a generic monster; keep faction law, materials, motives, and silhouette intact.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: It may appear in enemy-controlled zones, border conflicts, Gate events, pursuits, trials, bargains, or defensive reactions when the mission gives a lore-valid reason.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Visuals must follow: Many-eyed gold-white censor form, small wing arrays, scriptless auras, incense-fire censer. Abilities — Censure Beam, Aura Sight, Contradiction Brand — must telegraph clearly for mobile one-Deity-vs-many combat.

Visuals must follow: Many-eyed gold-white censor form, small wing arrays, scriptless halos, incense-fire censer. Abilities — Censure Beam, Halo Sight, Contradiction Brand — must telegraph clearly for mobile one-Deity-vs-many combat.

developmentStatus: Readable faction run-in creature profile integrated into mission/event encounter pools.
